notes: Gurugram is NOT in NCRB's metropolitan-city table (population was <2M per 2011 Census), so per-category city totals are stitched from local police press summaries reported in The Tribune. 2022 entry is carried verbatim from data/cities/gurugram/monthly_stats.json (sourced from Tribune 'Looking Back 2022' + Oct-2023 Tribune snatching tally): theft (4400) folds vehicle theft (3523) + snatching (218) + other theft estimate; assault (150) ~= murder (88) + attempt-to-murder (59); burglary, sexual_offence, harassment, kidnapping, robbery, other are best-effort estimates from partial Tribune / Hindustan Times reporting. 2021 entry derived from the same Tribune 'Looking Back 2022' article's year-over-year comparison: murder=75, attempt-to-murder=50 -> assault=125; vehicle-theft=3594, snatching=170 -> theft=3764. Categories without a primary-source 2021 figure (robbery, sexual_offence, harassment, kidnapping, burglary, other) are null per the project's hard rule (do not fabricate). 2019, 2020 and 2023 omitted: 2019/2020 had no Tribune year-end summary surfacing in the search corpus, and 2023 data is only partial (Jan-Oct from Tribune snatching article: murder 61, ATM 44, theft 256, snatching 130) which would not be comparable to full-year YTD figures. Replace once Gurugram Police starts publishing a structured annual crime PDF.
